newsitem.title: USA: Data Broadcast launches Internet service.
newsitem.headline: Data Broadcast launches Internet service.

text.p: Data Broadcasting Corp announced Tuesday the launch of its AgCast Network, an Internet-based agricultural data service.

The service, which costs $29.95 per month to access, provides customized agribusiness information, such as commodities and futures pricing, news, weather, stock quotes and market analysis, the company said.
A Data Broadcast spokesman said AgCast Network clients must already have an Internet service provider.
Data Broadcast provides market data to investors. Its shares were trading up 1/8 Tuesday at 7-3/4.
